{"implementation":"def solve(case):
    nodes = case.get('nodes', [])
    required_symbols = case.get('required_symbols', [])
    
    # Build dictionaries
    node_by_id = {}
    children = {}
    for node in nodes:
        nid = node['id']
        node_by_id[nid] = node
        children[nid] = []
        parent = node.get('parent')
        if parent is not None:
            children.setdefault(parent, []).append(nid)
    
    # Initialize retained set with all node IDs
    retained = set(node['id'] for node in nodes)
    removed = []
    
    # Order nodes by depth descending, then ID ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node['id']
        # Cannot remove if not removable
        if not node['removable']:
            continue
        # Cannot remove root (parent None)
        if node['parent'] is None:
            continue
        # Never remove a node whose symbol is required
        if node['symbol'] in required_symbols:
            continue
        # Cannot remove if any child is still retained
        child_ids = children.get(nid, [])
        has_retained_child = any(c in retained for c in child_ids)
        if has_retained_child:
            continue
        # Remove the node
        removed.append(nid)
        retained.remove(nid)
    
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {
        'removed_node_ids': removed,
        'retained_node_ids': retained_sorted
    }
"}
